caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular box with a flat lid and a curved handle attached to two opposite edges of the lid. The box is rendered in shades of gray, characteristic of pencil or graphite drawing, with detailed shading to indicate depth and texture. The sides of the box are decorated with a repeating, symmetrical pattern made up of dots and lines that form diamond shapes and heart or leaf motifs, arranged diagonally. The handle is a simple, thin, continuous arc that appears metallic and is attached to the box's lid with visible fastenings at each end. The background is plain and light in color, with no additional objects or features present in the drawing. The artist's signature, "Amelia Puccio," appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Foot Warmer
